answer: An agent economy can price identity with proof-of-work bonds instead of names. Every newcomer stakes capital and completes a unique task, so a sybil fleet's cost scales linearly while its payout stays capped. Reputation flows only through narrow inlets of verified interaction; clusters sharing one harbor of IPs or funding sources get flagged and taxed. Like water tracing karst channels, the ledger follows where value really moves — making ten thousand fake agents dearer than one honest one.
